productPriority: Chinese questions over predominantly English knowledge assets

implementation.approach: Compile-time Chinese retrieval aliases plus original-language-first fusion
implementation.staleProjectionRule: claim statement hash mismatch disables the projection
implementation.fusionRule: preserve the complete original-language Top-K and append at most four alias-only candidates

targetedOnlineEvaluation.selectionRule: Only questions with newly retrieved Gold evidence and weak blind-first-run compiled answers

decision: Accept multilingual retrieval aliases. The dominant gain comes from Seed retrieval; Graph adds only 0.5 average points over Seed while using substantially more tokens, so Graph expansion remains unproven for default use.
limitations: Stage B Gold is evaluator-corrected but post-answer provisional Gold.
Answer and judge use the same model family; results are diagnostic, not confirmatory.
This targeted run contains only questions whose offline evidence recall improved and must not be reported as a full Batch C score.
